from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0084.png'))
# Find jug pixels (blue: B > R + 30)
jug_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > img[:, :, 0] + 50) & (img[:, :, 2] > 150)
ys, xs = np.where(jug_mask)
print(f'Jug pixel bounds: xs=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], ys=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}]')
print(f'Jug base row: {ys.max()}, col center: {xs[ys == ys.max()].mean()}')

# Also find wall corner
# Wall is white (R>240, G>240, B>240), floor is tan (R~160, G~150, B~140)
# Look at column 313
for r in range(300, 400):
    if img[r, 313, 0] < 200:
        print(f'Floor boundary at col 313: row {r}')
        break
